name: Normative references
abstract: Clause 3 of OGC API - Common - Part 1: Core: normative references (the informative ones are in the Bibliography).

sources.title: OGC 19-072 — OGC API - Common - Part 1: Core — Normative references

description:
The following documents are referred to in the text in such a way that some or all of their content
constitutes requirements of this document. For dated references, only the edition cited applies. For
undated references, the latest edition of the referenced document (including any amendments) applies.
